svg.title: Step 3: Contact route (now versus target)
svg.desc: Step 3 Contact route. Now: First e-mail found in the post text; No address class; No source, excerpt or confidence stored; Company taken from the e-mail domain; No e-mail means a dead end. Target: Route hierarchy, first that exists; Provenance on every route; "Verified" means published, nothing more; Never. Metric: 100% of sends carry a source_url and excerpt; wrong-recipient replies = 0.
